# An update merges the payload and answers 302 with a match stub

**Claim.** The payload is merged into the record: fields in the body are overwritten, fields left out keep their values. The response is a 302 whose Location points back at the person and whose body is the same match stub find returns — not the updated person.

Applies to: `~1people~1{vanId}/post`

## Observed exchange

_A person whose first name is about to change._

```http
(setup) POST /people/create

{
  "firstName": "Corazon",
  "lastName": "Ellsworth-{scope}"
}

→ 201
  Location: https://api.securevan.com/v4/people/100000001
{
  "vanId": 100000001,
  "status": "Stored"
}
```

_Send only the new first name._

```http
POST /people/100000001

{
  "firstName": "Cora"
}

→ 302
  Location: https://api.securevan.com/v4/people/100000001
{
  "vanId": 100000001,
  "status": "Matched"
}
```

_The first name changed; the last name, absent from the body, survived._
